correctness.rationale: Summing/differencing the stationary directional equations gives Sprime=-r*rho and Rprime=-(r+alpha)*sigma. Decay at infinity and continuity of transport flux at the interface imply conserved S²-(r/(r+alpha))R²=0 in both phases; outward sign yields sigma=sqrt(r/(r+alpha))*rho and inverse-flux ODE Fprime(rho)*rhoprime=-Gamma*rho. Strict increasing unbounded liquid flux fixes center and dense width, and F_gprime(0)>0 makes gas spatial tail infinite. Source current jump at x=0 and exact phase masses follow integration; gas mass 2F*/Gamma is independent of gas constitutive shape under fixed contact flux. Power-law F_l=c*rho^p yields b proportional (t^(-1/p)-t^(-1))/(p-1) or log(t)/t; differentiation shows unique maximizing t=p^(p/(p-1)) or e. Independently differentiated p=1/2 giving t=2. These are existence/uniqueness only within the imposed symmetric single-core phase arrangement.
